messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: missing tabs problem
parts:
Hi Asma,

There Variables and Sample tabs have become the Select tab in the
current version of Rattle.

Also, to see the Cluster tab click on the "Unsupervised" radio button
at the top right of the interface. You should see Cluster and
Associate.

Build a cluster and have a look at the Log tab to see how to do
clustering in R.

Hope that helps....

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: 86d6314054c3caa3
messages.subject: Installing R on MS windows
parts: I followed ur guidlines and have successfully installed R on windows XP

I am listing the steps that i went through so maybe others can have
idea....
Installing R on  MS Windows operating system WITH GUI
1. DOWNLOAD THE FOLLOWING

"XML")
2.STEPS TO INSTALL R
 1.Install the GTK+ libraries "gtk-dev-2.10.11-win32-1 11.9 MB"
 2.Install R "R-2.5.1-win32 28 MB"
 3.Make a folder on ur hard disk like "C://ABC" n place all R packages in it and also place
   rattle_2.2.60 370 kB + RGtk2_2.10.11 14.7 MB in it.
 4.Than right click on R icon on desktop , in quick launch bar and in start
   menu and select properties, select shortcut tab and set start-in to
   the path of ur working directory u created in step 3
 5.Install RGtk2 "RGtk2_2.10.11 14.7 MB"  by selecting packages tab from R
   and choosing option "install packages from local zip files..." from
   the directory u have created in step 3 and where u have already placed
   all the required R packages listed in step 5 of 1 + rattle_2.2.60 370 kB
   + RGtk2_2.10.11 14.7 MB.
 6.Install R Packages like "ada" etc in the same way mentioned above instep 5.
 7.Install Rattle "rattle_2.2.60 370 kB" in the same way mentioned above in step 5.
 8.Start Rattle by typing library(rattle) on command line and press enter
 9.To start the Rattle GUI simply run the command:
   rattle()
Regards
